title: Apply -34 availability relevance and busyStatus confirmed rules
description: fffa992 (#447): events the Principal declined or delegated are not relevant; 'confirmed' = status confirmed AND (Principal not a participant OR accepted OR owner with needs-action). backend.rs:1043-1045 and calendars-types availability.rs:16 still state the old rule; MemoryBackend get_availability returns [] (memory.rs:1805). Update docs; consider a shared pure helper busy_status_for(event, principal_addrs) in calendars-types with tests.
